shortDescription: A whale has become the largest holder of MEME after buying 20.31 million tokens over the past 10 days. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the whale spent $1.04 million on the purchases, and the holdings are now worth about $930,000.The average purchase price was $0.051 per token.
